model.name: R20.29: Trace tree renders Method→Impl→Test→Gate chain matching the detail view.
model.description: The /trace TREE must render the full chain from Method downward: Method→Impl→Test→Gate — matching what the detail view traces. Currently the tree shows Method with 0 children (no Impl/Test/Gate nodes expand under it) even though the detail view traces impl. The chain must complete to a green Gate in the tree AND populate the Last-Completed slot when gated. Tron evidence: IMG_4060 (Method=0 in tree but detail shows impl).
model.tronQuote: > TRON (IMG_4060): trace tree must render Method→Impl→Test→Gate matching the detail (currently Method=0 in tree but detail traces impl).
model.crossRefNote: BUG7 (Class all-children) was a similar gap at the Class level. R20.29 is the Method level: tree must expand Method→Impl→Test→Gate.

intendedChain.useCase: traceTree.methodChainExpands — Method node in tree expands to show Impl→Test→Gate children
intendedChain.method: FORWARD_KEYS resolution for Method type must include implementations[] and continue to tests[]→gates[]
intendedChain.test: RED: expand a Method node in /trace tree → assert Impl child renders, expand Impl → Test renders, expand Test → Gate renders (if exists). Currently FAILS (Method shows 0 children).

architectDesign.diagnosis: CHAIN_TYPE_CONFIG (chain-model.ts:20) shows Method.scenarioFwd=["implementations"], Method.traceFwd=["implementations"]. Config is CORRECT. But Method scenario units in the index have EMPTY implementations[] arrays — the forward-ref was never populated by populate-forward-refs.ts for Method→Impl because [impl:uuid:] markers in source map to Implementation units whose parent is Method, but the Method unit never got its implementations[] array backfilled.
architectDesign.rootCause: populate-forward-refs.ts fills Requirement.useCases, Task.useCases, UseCase.classes, Class.methods — but the Method→Implementation→Test→Gate chain is populated by scanRepo graph linkage, NOT by the scenario pipeline. The /api/trace/children endpoint falls back to scanRepo (server.ts:764-777) when scenario index has empty arrays. So the tree CAN show them IF scanRepo finds them — but only if [impl:uuid:] markers exist in source AND the Implementation unit exists in the index.

fix.step1_pipeline: Extend populate-forward-refs.ts to backfill Method.implementations[] from Implementation units (Implementation.ownerIor → Method UUID). Similarly Implementation.tests[] from Test units. And Test.gates[] from Gate units.
fix.step2_verify_data: Run the extended pipeline. Measure: count Method units with non-empty implementations[], Implementation units with non-empty tests[], Test units with non-empty gates[].
fix.step3_no_code_change_needed_in_tree: rb-trace-tree already uses /api/trace/children which reads CHAIN_TYPE_CONFIG fwdKeys. Once the scenario units have populated forward arrays, the tree will render Method→Impl→Test→Gate without any client code change.

architectDesign.gate: Expand Method node in /trace tree → Impl child renders. Expand Impl → Test renders. Expand Test → Gate renders. DET-3x.
